The implication encodes that when accounting is increased and transferFrom incomplete, no reentrant entrypoint is invoked, matching the no-reentrancy-window intent.
The predicate directly represents the existence of a clear reentrancy window usable for griefing.

piv_relation.reason: Evidence e_3d4f02f16ebd_0003 and e_3d4f02f16ebd_0004 explicitly state that re-entering during transferFrom while accounting is increased produces a griefing-usable reentrancy window, bridging P/I to V.

evidence.text: Distributor.addRewards updates internal pending-reward accounting before performing the external transferFrom call. A malicious token can re-enter during transferFrom and call claimRewards (or other entrypoints) while accounting has already been increased, producing a clear reentrancy window that can be used for griefing and, in some scenarios, monetary extraction.

Attackers can force the code path to re-enter claimRewards during addRewards, demonstrating an exploitable reentrancy window. This enables griefing and may be combined with other weaknesses to steal tokens.
